title: docs(skills): a person confirms a gated MCP action; `run_action` and `resume_run` take no `confirm`
body:
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBHxRfV2uS8FfXKS2GKpWwxL)_ Fixes #34210 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none Skills-docs: updated here ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么:`objectstack-ai` 技能的 MCP 工具表里,`run_action` 一行不再教「先问人,再带 `confirm: true` 重试」,改为:声明了 `ai.requiresConfirmation: true` 的动作不会在这次调用里执行,交给本人在应用里确认,回答是 `status: 'pending_confirmation'` 加 `pendingId`;表下新增一段,教「不要发 `confirm`」、没有确认服务时的 428 `no_confirmation_service`、以及 stdio 长连接上的客户端内提问和三个拒绝原因。`objectstack-platform` 技能在 `requires:` 的规则里加第六条:AI 门的确认是宿主自己注册的服务。评测夹具加三例。 - 为什么改:运行时已经改了(调用方的 `confirm` 不再算数,并且带上它就被拒),而技能还在教旧写法。照旧文写的 agent 每次都会被拒,还会把「已交给本人」当成失败去重试。 - 风险与回滚:只动已发布技能的文字、评测夹具、一个 changeset 和 token 棘轮的一行,不动运行时与契约。`objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` 的上限按实测从 6011 提到 6145(+134),先删了同文件两处重复。回滚即 revert 本 PR。 - 先看:① `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` 的 `run_action` 行和表下新段(与 `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts` 的 `handOffActionConfirmation` / `elicitActionConfirmation` 是否一致);② `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` 的第六条规则和两处删除是否确为重复;③ `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 新加的那段算术。 - 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期看到 `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md is 6145 tokens (ceiling 6145; headroom 0)` 且以 ✓ 收尾。 - 需要你做的:`skills/**` 属受管面,席位合同复审 PASS 后请批准本 PR 一次;若低风险技能臂读作 Tier S 则无,席位落地。 ## What changes `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, section "MCP — the open-edition AI path", the `list_actions`, `run_action`, `resume_run` row of the tool table. Before, the row said: > An action flagged `ai.requiresConfirmation` (`list_actions` reports it) is refused with the same 428 unless the call sends `confirm: true`, and nothing runs — ask the human first, then retry. After: > An action declaring `ai.requiresConfirmation: true` (`list_actions` reports it) never runs on the call: the host's pending-confirmation service hands it to the person the call runs as, who approves or rejects it in the app, and the answer is `status: 'pending_confirmation'` with a `pendingId` — a success, so relay its message and do not retry. The service-account sentence of the same row now names the reason (`details.reason: 'service_account'`, at every action door), and the row's last sentence adds that a handed-off `resume_run` stays paused. One paragraph is added under the table: > **Never send `confirm` to `run_action` or `resume_run`:** a call carrying it is refused, on every action. A host with no such service (the open build ships none) refuses a gated call 428, `details.reason: 'no_confirmation_service'`: the person performs it in the app. On a long-lived (stdio) server whose bridge serves these tools, a client advertising form-mode `elicitation` is asked instead: `accept` runs it once; decline, dismissal or five minutes unanswered refuse it (`declined` / `cancelled` / `timed_out`). Over Streamable HTTP nobody is asked. The `delete_record` and `delete_records` rows are not touched: those tools still read `confirm: true` (citation (e) below). `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`, section "`requires:` — which service plugins boot": "Five rules that change what you write" becomes six. The new rule: > **AI-door confirmation is a service you register.** `mcp`'s `run_action` and `resume_run` never run an action declaring `ai.requiresConfirmation: true` on the call, and refuse any call that sends `confirm`. Register an `IActionConfirmationService` under `'ai.actionConfirmation'` and the person gets the hand-off (`status: 'pending_confirmation'`, a `pendingId`); with none (the open build) the call is refused 428, `details.reason: 'no_confirmation_service'`. An AI service account is refused `service_account`; a stdio client asked through `elicitation`, `declined` / `cancelled` / `timed_out`: objectstack-ai → **MCP**. This file had 5 tokens of headroom, so the rule is paid for under the standing ruling 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 (ruling record 6513306068, letter B). Two restatements are cut first, each keeping its other home in the file: - Dropped: "Never rebuild what the platform owns." at the end of the App / Platform Boundary intro. Still carried by the first bullet directly under it ("Business features belong in the app; capability belongs in the platform") and the third ("no hand-written predicate re-implementing a platform rule"). - Dropped: "(this is what `os dev` / `os serve` register)" in the `HonoServerPlugin` row of the HTTP Layer table. Still carried by step 4 of the Runtime Boot Sequence, which lists `HonoServerPlugin` among the plugins the CLI registers under `os serve` / `os dev`. Arithmetic in priced bytes (the release-stamp line excluded): 24021 on the merge base (6006 tokens, ceiling 6011, headroom 5). The cuts remove 84 bytes and the rule adds 640, so the landed text is 24577 bytes, 6145 tokens. `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` moves that one row 6011 → 6145 (+134, the measured remainder, pinned at the measurement) with the arithmetic in its comment. The `objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` row is not touched: 6068 → 6268 against a ceiling of 6801. Evals, three appended cases in each file's own layout: - `skills/objectstack-ai/evals/skills-tools-knowledge.json` id 7: an agent that asks in chat and retries `run_action` with `confirm: true` and is now refused. The answer drops the member, relays the `pending_confirmation` answer and its `pendingId` without retrying, and names the `no_confirmation_service` refusal on a host with no service. - Same file, id 8: a stdio server whose host bridge serves the action tools, a client that shows the question, and the same action called under an AI service account's own key. The answer gives what `accept` does, the three refusal reasons, that Streamable HTTP asks nobody, and the `service_account` refusal. - `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json` id 23: a self-hosted deployment that sees every gated call refused `no_confirmation_service` and wants its people to approve in its app. The answer is a plugin registering an `IActionConfirmationService` under `'ai.actionConfirmation'`, whose `submit` returns the `pendingId`. `.changeset/34210-skills-mcp-action-confirmation-hand-off.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch. Line budget. The order gave net +15 lines across the two `SKILL.md` files, priced teaching text, with evals reported separately (ruling record 6513306068: eval fixtures are outside the ratchet's priced population). Readings: `objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` +8 (434 → 442), `objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` +7 (414 → 421, eight lines added and one removed with the first cut), together +15. Evals: +20 lines and +18 lines. Authoring tier: `dispatch-gates --tier` answers MANDATORY CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER for `skills/**` (clause ①, no one-line exit). This card thread is served at that tier (`Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, read from the session record), so the diff was authored in the thread itself. ## Code citations Each taught fact was read from code on the merge base `ec6b5fd3` before any text was written.
(a) The hand-off, the pending answer and the no-service refusal `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts`, `aiDoorConfirmation` (line 3162): an action whose `ai.requiresConfirmation` is not `true` is admitted; an AI service account is refused; every other caller is handed off. The request is not a parameter, so the caller's `confirm` cannot be read. `handOffActionConfirmation` (line 3220): with no service resolved under `ACTION_CONFIRMATION_SERVICE` it returns the refusal with reason `'no_confirmation_service'` (line 3236), whose message ends "Perform the action in the app instead."; with one, it calls `service.submit(handOff, ec)` and returns `status: 'pending_confirmation'` (line 3250) with the service's `pendingId` and a message. A service that answers no `pendingId` throws. `packages/spec/src/contracts/ai-service.ts`: `ACTION_CONFIRMATION_SERVICE = 'ai.actionConfirmation'` (line 751), `IActionConfirmationService` with its one member `submit(handOff, context)` answering a `pendingId` (lines 775-784), `ActionConfirmationPending` (line 732, "A success, not a refusal"). The docblock on the service says the open-source deployment registers none. A host registers it with `ctx.registerService(ACTION_CONFIRMATION_SERVICE, …)` in a plugin's `init`: `packages/qa/dogfood/test/action-confirmation-handoff-33690.dogfood.test.ts`, line 90.
(b) The refusal reasons, the status and the service-account refusal `packages/spec/src/contracts/ai-service.ts`, `ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REFUSAL_REASONS` (line 684): `declined`, `cancelled`, `timed_out`, `no_confirmation_service`, `service_account`, a closed set carried as `details.reason`. `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts`: `ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED_CODE = 'ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED'` (line 3044) and `ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED_STATUS = 428` (line 3053). `actionConfirmationRefusal` (line 3075) answers reason `'service_account'` (line 3102) for an AI service account whatever the request carries; its comment says the reason is carried "at every door".
(c) The in-client question and its three refusals; which door can ask `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts`, `elicitActionConfirmation` (line 3336): `accept` answers accepted and the caller dispatches once; `decline` is refused `'declined'` (line 3354), no answer in time `'timed_out'` (line 3364), anything else `'cancelled'` (line 3373). Nothing is handed off on any of them. `packages/mcp/src/action-confirmation-elicitation.ts`: `ACTION_CONFIRMATION_ELICITATION_TIMEOUT_MS = 5 * 60_000` (line 63); `actionConfirmationElicitorFor` (line 188) answers no elicitor unless the client advertised form-mode `elicitation` on this server (line 194). The module header says the per-request Streamable HTTP server never read the client's `initialize`, so it never elicits. The card for in-client confirmation on the HTTP door is open and on hold, so the HTTP door keeps the hand-off. `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`, lines 3582 and 3680: `run_action` and `resume_run` pass the elicitor to the bridge only when one exists. Why the skill says "whose bridge serves these tools": `wireBridgeTools` (same file, line 2211) registers the action tools only when the bridge implements `listActions` and `runAction` (line 2220). The stdio bridge the plugin wires, `createStdioDataBridge` (`packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.ts`, line 1151; `packages/mcp/src/plugin.ts`, lines 807 and 923), returns a data bridge with neither member. So on the plugin's own stdio transport `run_action` is not registered, which the row already said before this change ("the stdio bridge does not, so it serves none"). The in-client question is reached on a long-lived server that a host gives an action-carrying bridge (`MCPServerRuntime.bridgeDataTools`).
(d) A call that carries confirm is refused on both tools `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`, `RETIRED_CONFIRMATION_MEMBER` (line 2163), passed as `retired:` to the closed input of `run_action` (line 3476) and `resume_run` (line 3634). Its docblock: the refusal is the closed input's unknown-key refusal, it arrives before the bridge is called, and it applies "on EVERY action, gated or not". Pinned by `packages/mcp/src/mcp-action-confirmation-member.test.ts` ("REFUSES a retry carrying `confirm: true` at the input: the bridge never sees it").
(e) The delete tools still read confirm, so their rows are left alone `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`, `isDeleteConfirmed` (line 1275): `return request[AI_ACTION_CONFIRMATION_MEMBER] === true;`, one predicate for `delete_record` and `delete_records`, and both tools still declare the member in their input (lines 3167 and 3270).
## Tests No package source changes, so there is no package test to run and nothing to ablate. The three eval cases are fixtures (measured, not ratcheted) and are self-consistent: every `must_contain` string appears in its case's `expected_output`, no `must_not_contain` string does, and the ids in each file are distinct (8 and 23; checked by script).

## Acceptance notes - The card says both skills "name the gate". Measured on the merge base, `objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` named it in one place only, the customization paragraph (an override turning `ai.requiresConfirmation` off is refused), which stays true and is not touched. The host-side teaching went under `requires:`, next to the rules about what a host mounts, because `mcp` is a host default and the confirmation service is one a host registers. - The in-client question is taught with its real reach (citation (c)): the plugin's own stdio transport serves no action tools, so the skill says "a long-lived (stdio) server whose bridge serves these tools" and does not say that any stdio client is asked. Noted, not filed. - The `delete_record` row still says "ask the human first, then retry". The tool's own description now also says that a request naming one record with exactly one match is the approval (`DELETE_NAMED_RECORD_IS_APPROVAL`, `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`). That is a different gate from this card's, so the row is left as it is. Noted, not filed. - The `objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` ceiling row is left at 6801 (headroom 533). ## Verification
